title: BIOLOG migration record
description: ADR-0005 Decision 1.1/3.4. A proposal Kemi has assigned a sequence number to. Immutable once written - a later mistake is corrected by a new, later record, never by editing this one. Only a record is ever applied to a real database. Examples are SYNTHETIC.

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing, gapless, assigned ONLY by Kemi (ADR-0005 Decision 1.2). Never computed by a proposer.

assigned_by.description: Always Kemi (ADR-0005 Decision 1.2). Recorded, not merely implied, so the audit trail names who assigned every sequence position.
